declarations.name: ObjCBool
declarations.comment:
The Objective-C BOOL type.

On 64-bit iOS, the Objective-C BOOL type is a typedef of C/C++
bool. Elsewhere, it is "signed char". The Clang importer imports it as
ObjCBool.

members.name: boolValue
members.comment: The value of `self`, expressed as a `Bool`.

declarations.name: ObjCBool.BooleanLiteralType
declarations.comment: A type that represents a Boolean literal, such as `Bool`.

declarations.name: Selector
declarations.comment:
The Objective-C SEL type.

The Objective-C SEL type is typically an opaque pointer. Swift
treats it as a distinct struct type, with operations to
convert between C strings and selectors.

The compiler has special knowledge of this type.

members.name: init
members.comment: Create a selector from a string.

declarations.name: Selector.ExtendedGraphemeClusterLiteralType
declarations.comment:
A type that represents an extended grapheme cluster literal.

Valid types for `ExtendedGraphemeClusterLiteralType` are `Character`,
`String`, and `StaticString`.

declarations.name: Selector.StringLiteralType
declarations.comment:
A type that represents a string literal.

Valid types for `StringLiteralType` are `String` and `StaticString`.

declarations.name: Selector.UnicodeScalarLiteralType
declarations.comment:
A type that represents a Unicode scalar literal.

Valid types for `UnicodeScalarLiteralType` are `Unicode.Scalar`,
`Character`, `String`, and `StaticString`.

globals.name: objc_enumerateClasses
globals.signature: func objc_enumerateClasses(fromImage: ObjCEnumerationImage = .machHeader(#dsohandle), matchingNamePrefix: String? = nil, conformingTo: Protocol? = nil, subclassing: AnyClass? = nil) -> ObjCClassList
globals.comment:
Enumerates classes, filtering by image, name, protocol conformance and superclass.

- Parameter fromImage: The image to search; defaults to the caller's image.
- Parameter matchingNamePrefix: If specified, a required prefix for the class name.
- Parameter conformingTo: If specified, a protocol to which the enumerated classes must conform.
- Parameter subclassing: If specified, a class which the enumerated classes must subclass.

- Returns: A `Sequence` of classes that match the search criteria.
globals.typescript: objc_enumerateClasses(fromImage?: ObjCEnumerationImage, matchingNamePrefix?: (string) | null, conformingTo?: (string) | null, subclassing?: (string) | null): ObjCClassList
